juvenile male alligators from contaminated Lake Apopka in central Florida have depressed testosterone and estradiol- 17 beta concentrations and poorly organized testes.
juvenile alligators from a lake contaminated with estrogenic pesticides have abnormal plasma hormone concentrations and gonadal development.
